docs.text: Installation ¶ Currently this project is built as an RPM package for RHEL8 and later. The RPM will install the binaries to /opt/dans.knaw.nl/dd-manage-deposit-cli and the configuration files to /etc/opt/dans.knaw.nl/dd-manage-deposit-cli . Building from source ¶ Prerequisites: Java 21 or higher Maven 3.8.7 or higher RPM Steps: git clone https://github.com/DANS-KNAW/dd-manage-deposit-cli.git cd dd-manage-deposit-cli mvn clean install
